text: One of the most dumb ass rhetorics I hear from dudes when it comes to dating is how many of them think that women use them for free meals when it comes to dates. Sorry. Like do you genuinely think we are on some poverty line that like I can't pay for a fucking dinner. Hi guy. I go to these dinners on my own. Nobody needs your bum ass free meal man. Just admit you can't afford it and go. Maybe you're projecting that because you want the free meal. Look guys. Are there women out there who go on dates just for a free meal. Yes of course there are. In fact there is even a study about this. A paper published in Social Psychological and Personality Science in 2019 looked at something called foodie calls. According to their results about a quarter to a third of women in those samples admitted going to a date just to get a free meal at least once in their life. So the phenomenon definitely exists. But here's the important part. That fact shouldn't discourage you from going on dates because even if some women have done this once in their life it doesn't mean that this is the main reason women go on dates. Most women go on dates for the normal reasons people in general go on dates to spend time together to get to know someone to see if there's potential between you and remember something important. Most women have busy lives too. They work they study they have friends hobbies sports and unlike many men even the average woman usually has multiple options for dates. So if she chooses to spend an evening with you it is normally because she decided to get to know you better. Second point you don't have to take a girl to dinner in the first place. It is completely normal to invite a girl to a coffee shop or a bar just for some drinks. Most women have no problem with that type of date. And if a girl insists that the first meeting must be a full dinner in a restaurant I would honestly recommend not even meeting her. Experience shows that women who already have a wish list for dates before you even met usually do not go well at all. Now that doesn't mean you should never go to a restaurant. If that is your lifestyle and you enjoy that kind of evening great do it because you want to do it. But if in your normal life you rarely go to restaurants and suddenly start doing it just to impress a girl that will probably play against you. Better spend that money and take your mom to a nice restaurant. She will appreciate it much more. Now the third point should you pay on the date. There's a lot of talk today about equality going 50 50 women being independent and so on which is all good. But unfortunately or maybe fortunately we live in a world full of double standards. Some of them play to our advantage. Some of them play against us when it comes to paying on date. The real question is this. Do you want to be equal and fair or do you want to be effective. If you want to be effective meaning that more of your dates lead to the outcomes you hope for kissing taking the girl home or the story continuing in some way then you should pay on the date. If you want to be perfectly equal and fair you can go 50 50. Just don't be surprised later if your effectiveness takes a hit. So overall don't overthink dates. Don't believe those scary stories that all women just want free meals and are not interested in you. Remember the first rule of the date is to have fun vibe and enjoy your time together. Then comes experience and only then comes result. So go on dates enjoy your evenings and have fun.
